trimmedBy: node trim-ats-a-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by job id (meta.total rewritten to the kept count so the envelope stays self-consistent), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify, prettier); never a byte cut
notes: 191 jobs captured, 3 kept: a plain city (Bangalore), a Legal job in Tokyo, and a Paris job whose location.name has a trailing space and whose first_published equals updated_at. Two e-mail addresses per body were redacted. Whole response 2.7 MB. OWNERSHIP VERIFIED from the payload: company_name is "Airbnb" on 191 of 191 jobs and absolute_url hosts are careers.airbnb.com with gh_jid. Documented (https://docs.greenhouse.io/job-board.html): GET endpoints need no authentication ("Job Board data is publicly available"); only the application POST needs Basic auth. robots.txt of boards-api.greenhouse.io: User-agent * / Disallow: /embed/ only, so /v1/boards/{token}/jobs is allowed. The docs state no rate limit or terms of use. Job content is HTML-escaped by Greenhouse (entities) and the adapter decodes it once. company_name and first_published appear on every job of this response although the docs show them only in the single-job example. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
